verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a REST interface, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for it, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The generated TypeScript SDKs and per-server MCP server cards are adjacent features: they are not a machine-readable spec of Smithery's own API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
